@graph.headline: Introducing LettersToMy: A Private Family Time Capsule Built for Apple Devices
@graph.description: LettersToMy is a privacy-first family time capsule for letters, memories, collaboration, and future delivery.

acceptedAnswer.text: LettersToMy is a private family time-capsule app for writing letters, saving media and memories, collaborating with trusted relatives, and making content available to a recipient in the future.
The current app is being developed first for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. A CloudKit-integrated web app is planned, followed later by Android.
The Apple-first version stores content locally and synchronizes it through the archive owner's iCloud account using private and shared CloudKit databases.
